run_cli_view_docling_json: run the docling CLI view command to open a Docling JSON file in the default browser
run_cli_view_docling_version: run the docling CLI with --version flag to display the installed docling-core version
load_docling_document_from_json: load a DoclingDocument from a JSON file using resolve_source_to_path and load_from_json
export_docling_document_to_html: export a DoclingDocument to HTML with embedded images using export_to_html and ImageRefMode.EMBEDDED
open_html_in_browser: open an HTML file in the default web browser using webbrowser.open with a file:// URL
